HomePage.title: LST Project
HomePage.description: A place to find, create, and review community subtitles so YouTube videos and live streams can be watched in more languages.
HomePage.searchPlaceholder: Video title, channel name, or YouTube URL
HomePage.feature1Desc: Community subtitles for all YouTube content — regular videos and live streams alike.
HomePage.feature2Desc: Install the extension to enable community subtitles directly on YouTube pages.
HomePage.feature3Desc: Channel owners review and approve subtitles, which are shown first to viewers.
HomePage.contextTitle: Picking up where YouTube left off
HomePage.contextDesc: In 2020, YouTube officially shut down its community captions feature. But the need for multilingual subtitles among creators and fans never went away — people still commission work through X(Twitter) DMs or share files privately. LST Project is a space where the community can fill that gap themselves.
